tags.name: ActiveRTAC
tags.tooltip: Current active RTAC ("A" or "B"). Mirrors MasterController unless ForcedRTAC overrides it. This is the operator-facing summary; the machine-readable version consumed by UDT instances is [default]SEL_Internal_Tags/ActiveProvider.

tags.name: ForcedRTAC
tags.tooltip: Operator override. "A" pins to GCSA, "B" pins to GCSB, anything else ("AUTO") lets MasterController decide.

tags.name: A_Healthy
tags.tooltip: TRUE when the GCSA_RTAC_MODBUS device connection is Connected at the gateway level.

tags.name: B_Healthy
tags.tooltip: TRUE when the GCSB_RTAC_MODBUS device connection is Connected at the gateway level.

tags.name: BothHealthy
tags.tooltip: TRUE when both RTAC Modbus connections are up — normal operating state.

tags.name: NeitherHealthy
tags.tooltip: TRUE when both RTAC connections are down — total outage. Good candidate for a critical alarm.

tags.name: LastFailoverTime
tags.tooltip: Timestamp of the last ActiveRTAC transition. Written by the tag-change script on ActiveRTAC.

tags.name: LastFailoverReason
tags.tooltip: Human-readable reason for the last transition. Written by the tag-change script on ActiveRTAC.

tags.name: FailoverCount
tags.tooltip: Cumulative count of ActiveRTAC transitions since gateway start. Consider adding history on this and resetting periodically.
